remarks: Welcome to 156 Rocky Rapids Road, a light-filled 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath center hall Colonial nestled on a picturesque, manicured level acre in North Stamford. Perfectly positioned with fabulous eastern, southern & western exposures; this home enjoys abundant natural sunlight throughout the day. Step inside to discover beautiful hardwood floors throughout, a welcoming entry foyer leading to a formal dining room, a spacious great room and formal living room- both featuring a charming see-through fireplace with mantels. The country-sized eat-in kitchen boasts a large deck overlooking the backyard & Mianus river, a separate pantry; the 2nd entry conveniently accesses the 2-car garage with 14-foot ceilings. The upper level offers a primary suite with full bath & 2 walk-in closets, along with three additional generously sized bedrooms and a full hall bath. The lower level provides ample storage and a perfect space for the handyman in the family. Additional features include: 4-zone oil-fired heating system with brand-new 40-gallon hot water heater & updated plumbing, a 2-zone central air system, a whole-house generator powered by propane, new roof & shed. With its timeless charm, hardwood floors throughout, sun-drenched living spaces (almost 3,000 sqft), this well-maintained home is a true gem. Don't miss this incredible opportunity!
